text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby narrowly missed out on 
victory in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. 
Though tasting bitter frustration, she 
looked forward, determined to push beyond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Daiichi Ruby acknowledges 
Daitaku Helios's speed. She hopes they 
will continue to compete as worthy rivals 
and elevate one another.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she expresses her wish to keep 
challenging GⅠ races, the Trainer suggests 
entering the Yasuda Kinen. Daitaku Helios 
announces her participation as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unusually for her, Daiichi Ruby checks the 
prospective runners for the Yasuda Kinen. 
Her Trainer senses that she truly longs to 
battle against a worthy rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next goal was set for the 
Yasuda Kinen. The two begin moving towards 
their new objective.
